tasks.content: Bootstrap Breakout game app from AppShell reference at apps/appshell/app/. Copy the entire apps/appshell/app/ directory to apps/breakout/app/, then update package.json name to '@breakout/frontend', update index.html page title to 'Breakout Game', update HomeScreen.tsx card title to 'Breakout' and welcome text, update AboutScreen.tsx subtitle to 'About Breakout Game'. Verify build and dev scripts work. See apps/breakout/docs/how/architecture.md for full context.

Implement Slice 1 (Foundation) — GameCanvas component with 60 FPS game loop and initial rendering. Read apps/breakout/docs/how/slices/slice-1-foundation/slice.md and implement: (1) Canvas 2D context initialization, (2) Game state interface with ball, paddle, bricks, lives, speedMultiplier, (3) requestAnimationFrame loop running at 60 FPS with deltaTime calculation, (4) Initial rendering of paddle (bottom center), ball (at paddle), brick grid (5 rows top), (5) Lives counter display (top-left), speed multiplier display (top-right). Game state should be in a useRef to avoid re-renders. Depends on AppShell (task A).

Implement Slice 2 (Physics) collision detection module. Read apps/breakout/docs/how/slices/slice-2-physics/slice.md and implement: (1) checkAABB(rect1, rect2) - detects AABB overlap, (2) checkCircleAABB(ball, rect) - detects circle-rectangle collision, (3) resolveBallCollision(ball, obstacle) - returns velocity components to reverse. All functions must be pure with no side effects. Test with unit tests in src/utils/collision.test.ts. Depends on AppShell (task A).

Integrate physics and collision detection into GameCanvas game loop (Slice 2). Update GameCanvas to: (1) Call collision detection functions each frame, (2) Resolve ball velocity on wall/paddle/brick collisions, (3) Mark destroyed bricks with alive=false, (4) Filter and remove dead bricks from state, (5) Ensure ball is constrained to canvas bounds. Physics update must apply speedMultiplier to velocity. See apps/breakout/docs/how/slices/slice-2-physics/slice.md for sequence flow. Depends on GameCanvas (task B) and collision module (task C).

Implement Slice 3 (Game States & Lives) — state machine and game lifecycle. Read apps/breakout/docs/how/slices/slice-3-game-states/slice.md and implement: (1) Phase transitions (menu → playing → gameOver/victory), (2) Lives management (start 3, decrement on ball loss, end game at 0), (3) Victory condition (all bricks destroyed), (4) Speed slider input (0.5x to 2.0x multiplier), (5) Menu overlay UI (start button, speed slider, game-over screen, victory screen), (6) Restart flow (reset lives, bricks, ball position). Console log phase transitions and lives changes. Depends on all previous physics tasks (B, C, D).

Create smoke tests for Breakout app. Test: (1) GameCanvas component mounts without crashing, (2) Canvas element renders, (3) Initial game state (3 lives, paddle visible, ball visible, brick grid present), (4) Browser console has no errors on load. Use Vitest + @testing-library/react. See apps/breakout/docs/how/architecture.md for component structure. Depends on all implementation tasks (B, C, D, E).
